QUOTE: "`MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is commented out in `include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:3787`. `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_ALT` are also commented out (lines 2185, 2196)."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states the shipped config leaves THREADING_C, PTHREAD and ALT all commented out, so the default build defines none of them.
